verdicts.evidence: In all three paragraphs (x about 120–750, y about 140–360) the lines sit about 15 px apart, so the descenders of "forty minutes" and "on after foot passengers" run into "takes about" and "the side of the deck" on the lines below.

Paragraphs 1 and 3 say "between early morning and late evening", "In winter the timetable thins" and "leaves the quay before dusk" without giving any times or dates, then send the reader to the printed timetables in the shelter.
